title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Horizontal vs Vertical Stripes
intuition: Smallest convolutional image transfer test: learn both 8x8 stripe orientations (horizontal and vertical) using a 32-particle prior with exact finite-prior enumeration (2/2 modes, hq >= 0.90).
failure_mode: Unregularized Conv2d critics or cross-valley barycentric averaging produce blurry '+' cross hybrids instead of crisp stripes.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required image task and Four Laws Adherence Law 2 anchor (600 updates).
